column1:
Look at your hands to see the controls for flying. If you ever want to see them again, you can find the controls button in the pop-up menu under settings.

You can adjust your view by moving your hands close together and then holding the grab button on both controllers. Then move your hands to change your view.

Enjoy your flight!
column2:
低头看自己的双手即可看到飞行操作提示。如果想再次查看，可以在设置里的弹出菜单中找到操作提示按钮。

将双手靠近并同时按住两个控制器的抓取键，即可调整视角。然后移动双手来改变视角。

祝飞行愉快！

column1:
This setting changes the way reflections are handled on the craft surfaces.

Realtime: Reflective craft parts will reflect the surrounding world in realtime. Enabling this option can result in extreme performance impacts.

Static: Reflective craft parts will use a vague static image to give the illusion of the parts reflecting their surroundings without actually doing so.
column2:
此设置决定载具表面的反射处理方式。

实时：有反射效果的载具部件会实时反射周围环境。开启此项可能造成极大的性能开销。

静态：有反射效果的载具部件会使用一张模糊的静态图像，制造出反射周围环境的假象，实际并不反射。
